wiki_catalogs.name: Project Overview
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the MorganTraveler project overview section focused on Hong Kong's public transportation PWA. Explain its purpose as a Progressive Web Application combining MapLibre, PMTiles, and WASM RAPTOR routing engine to provide real-time transit information, route planning, and interactive mapping for Hong Kong's multi-modal transportation system. Document the project's architecture including edge computing with Cloudflare Pages Functions, offline support through service workers, and community contribution workflows. Include both conceptual overviews for beginners explaining transit data concepts and technical details for experienced developers covering the modern web stack. Use terminology consistent with the codebase such as GTFS data, vector tiles, and multi-modal routing. Provide practical examples demonstrating common use cases like route planning, real-time ETA checking, and station information lookup.

wiki_catalogs.name: Getting Started
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive getting started content for MorganTraveler focused on helping new users quickly set up and run the Hong Kong transit PWA. Document the project structure overview explaining key directories like src/ for source code, functions/ for edge computing, public/ for static assets, and scripts/ for automation. Provide initial configuration guidance including environment variables, Cloudflare Pages deployment setup, and local development workflow. Include troubleshooting common setup issues and verification steps to ensure proper installation. Use clear, beginner-friendly language while providing technical details for developers.

# MORGAN Travelers: Hong Kong Transit PWA - Comprehensive Project Analysis

## Project Introduction

**MORGAN Travelers** is a Progressive Web Application (PWA) designed for Hong Kong's public transportation system. The application provides real-time transit information, route planning, and interactive mapping capabilities specifically tailored for Hong Kong's complex multi-modal transit network including MTR (Mass Transit Railway), Light Rail, buses, minibuses, and ferries.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Real-time Transit Information**: Display live arrival times and route status for all major Hong Kong transit operators
- **Interactive Route Planning**: Provide intelligent trip planning with multiple routing algorithms and preferences
- **Offline-First Architecture**: Enable offline functionality through service workers and cached data
- **Community Contributions**: Allow users to contribute route corrections and improvements
- **Mobile-Optimized Experience**: Deliver a native-like experience on mobile devices with touch gestures and responsive design

### Target Audience
- Daily commuters in Hong Kong requiring reliable transit information
- Tourists navigating Hong Kong's complex transportation system
- Transit enthusiasts and urban planners interested in Hong Kong's mobility infrastructure
- Community contributors who want to improve transit data accuracy

## Technical Architecture

The application follows a modern progressive web app architecture with client-side rendering, WASM-based routing, and edge computing capabilities.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Client Browser] --> B[Vite Dev Server/Production Build]
    B --> C[MapLibre GL Map]
    B --> D[WASM Router Engine]
    B --> E[Service Worker]
    
    C --> F[PMTiles Vector Tiles]
    C --> G[Protomaps Basemap]
    
    D --> H[GTFS Data]
    D --> I[Routing Algorithms]
    
    E --> J[Offline Cache]
    E --> K[Background Sync]
    
    L[Edge Functions] --> M[GitHub API Integration]
    L --> N[Data Processing]
    L --> O[Override Management]
    
    P[Cloudflare R2] --> Q[Static Assets]
    P --> R[GTFS Archives]
    P --> S[Routing Graphs]
```

### Component Breakdown

**Frontend Layer**: Built with vanilla JavaScript and modern ES modules, utilizing MapLibre GL for interactive mapping and a custom routing engine powered by WebAssembly.

**Routing Engine**: Custom WASM implementation using RAPTOR (Rapid Algorithm for Public Transit Routing) optimized for Hong Kong's transit network characteristics.

**Data Pipeline**: Automated GTFS data collection, processing, and distribution pipeline with Cloudflare R2 storage and metadata generation.

**Contribution System**: GitHub-integrated workflow allowing community members to submit route corrections via pull requests with automated validation.

### Design Patterns

- **Module Federation**: Clean separation of concerns with dedicated modules for routing, mapping, data management, and UI components
- **Event-Driven Architecture**: Decoupled communication between components through custom events and state management
- **Strategy Pattern**: Multiple routing strategies (fastest, simplest, cheapest) with pluggable preference systems
- **Observer Pattern**: Real-time updates for transit information and route changes
- **Factory Pattern**: Dynamic loading of operator-specific data processors and formatters

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points
- **`index.html`**: Application shell with PWA manifest, critical CSS, and accessibility features
- **`src/main.js`**: Primary application bootstrap, map initialization, and core module orchestration
- **`vite.config.js`**: Development server configuration with custom middleware for GitHub OAuth and override management

### Core Modules
- **`src/router.ts`**: WASM router wrapper implementing RAPTOR algorithm with Hong Kong-specific optimizations
- **`src/mtrLayer.js`**: MTR station and line visualization with interchange handling
- **`src/eta.js`**: Estimated time of arrival calculations and live schedule integration
- **`src/preferences.js`**: User preference management with persistence and import/export capabilities

### Configuration Approach
- **Environment Variables**: Development and production configurations managed through Vite's environment system
- **Runtime Configuration**: Edge function configuration via Cloudflare Pages variables and secrets
- **Feature Flags**: Conditional feature activation based on environment and user capabilities

### External Dependencies
- **MapLibre GL v6**: Modern vector tile rendering engine with WebGL acceleration
- **PMTiles**: Efficient vector tile format for large geographic datasets
- **Protomaps Basemaps**: High-quality basemap tiles optimized for transit applications
- **WASM Router**: Custom-built routing engine compiled from Rust for optimal performance

### Integration Points
- **GitHub API**: Authentication and pull request automation for community contributions
- **Cloudflare R2**: Object storage for GTFS archives, routing graphs, and static assets
- **Edge Functions**: Serverless functions for authentication, data processing, and API endpoints
- **Service Workers**: Offline caching, background sync, and push notifications

### Component Relationships

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class MapEngine {
        +initialize()
        +renderRoutes()
        +updateStations()
        +handleInteractions()
    }
    
    class Router {
        +planTrip()
        +calculateETA()
        +optimizeRoute()
        +getPreferences()
    }
    
    class DataManager {
        +loadGTFS()
        +cacheData()
        +syncRemote()
        +validateIntegrity()
    }
    
    class UIController {
        +renderPanel()
        +handleInput()
        +updateStatus()
        +manageState()
    }
    
    MapEngine --> Router : uses
    DataManager --> MapEngine : provides data
    UIController --> DataManager : manages
    UIController --> MapEngine : controls
    Router --> DataManager : queries
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Real-Time Transit Information**: Live arrival predictions, route status monitoring, and service disruption alerts across all Hong Kong transit operators.

**Multi-Modal Route Planning**: Intelligent trip planning combining MTR, buses, light rail, minibuses, and walking with transfer optimization and fare calculation.

**Interactive Mapping**: Zoomable, pannable map with layered transit information, route visualization, and station details.

**Offline Support**: Full offline capability with cached schedules, maps, and routing data for areas with poor connectivity.

**Community Contributions**: Crowdsourced route corrections with GitHub integration for review and publication workflow.

### Implementation Highlights

- **WASM Routing Engine**: Custom-built RAPTOR implementation in Rust compiled to WebAssembly for sub-second route calculations
- **Vector Tile Rendering**: Efficient map rendering using PMTiles format with dynamic styling based on zoom level and user preferences
- **Progressive Enhancement**: Graceful degradation from full-featured desktop experience to simplified mobile interface
- **Accessibility First**: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with screen reader support, keyboard navigation, and high contrast modes

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Loading
    Loading --> MapReady: Data Loaded
    MapReady --> RoutePlanning: User Input
    MapReady --> StationInfo: Station Selected
    MapReady --> RouteView: Route Selected
    
    RoutePlanning --> ETA: Calculate
    ETA --> RouteView: Show Results
    StationInfo --> RoutePlanning: Plan From Here
    
    RouteView --> RoutePlanning: New Search
    RouteView --> StationInfo: View Details
    RouteView --> [*]: Exit
    
    StationInfo --> [*]: Back
```

The application demonstrates sophisticated architectural decisions including modular data loading, efficient caching strategies, and seamless integration between real-time data sources and offline capabilities. The contribution system represents a mature approach to community-driven data maintenance with proper validation and review workflows.
